(2) The customer satisfaction survey shall include questionnaire on various Quality of Service aspects of this regulation from the consumer perspective, as specified by the Authority. (3) The service provider shall, take all remedial action to rectify shortcomings or deficiencies, if any, observed in the result of the customer satisfaction survey and submit to the Authority─ (a) its action plan for removal of the shortcomings or deficiencies, within fifteen days of receipt of the communication from the Authority about such shortcomings or deficiencies; and (b) its compliance report, after completing the remedial action, within three months of submission of action plan and in case, remedial action is not completed within three months of submission of action plan, then a quarterly compliance report shall be submitted till completion of remedial action.
